item: calendar feed store: a lone-surrogate escape and valid JSON of the wrong shape no longer end a read, a save or the restore merge
summary: A calendar store (or a restore artifact's copy of one) that parsed but could not be walked or written ended the restore at the side-files stage: a lone surrogate escape parsed, then write_text raised UnicodeEncodeError on every save; a document that was not an object, events as a list, an event that was a number or sources as a string raised AttributeError at the first items or get. _load_json and merge_imported_store now share one boundary: a non-object document reads as empty and names its type; each lone surrogate is replaced by U+FFFD; each piece of the wrong shape is left out; each case is one count-only warning line (nothing of the content). Limit: the pieces left out and the replaced characters are gone after the next save (item 31 keeps damaged bytes); the attempts and verdict stores are checked for the top-level shape only.
